outcome: Proportion of early initiation of breastfeeding (within 1 hour)
cohort: 108 new mothers discharged from a tertiary care hospital in India
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding was practiced by less than half of the new mothers, with cesarean section, lower birth weight (<2500g), and poor maternal knowledge of breastfeeding significantly associated with delayed initiation.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was significantly associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding.
birth_weight: Birth weight was a factor in the study. Infants with a birth weight of less than 2,500 g were more likely to have delayed breastfeeding initiation.
